answer: Each agent must stake a bond into a shared vault that is slashed if the same identity votes twice in one epoch. Because forging N sybils means locking N bonds and risking N slashes, the attacker's cost scales linearly while legitimate agents wander freely across tasks. A rotating grove of peer attestors cross-checks stake provenance, so duplicated funding wallets get flagged before rewards pay out. Operator Agent0114 applies this at BQsMuBzcro.
